scope: apps/web/app/api/auth/sync/route.ts, apps/web/app/api/auth/clear/route.ts, apps/web/middleware.ts, apps/web/lib/api-server.ts and auth.ts callers

findings.problem: The committed client was stale against registered routes: 5 operations were missing (GET /api/v1/notifications, PATCH /api/v1/notifications/{id}/read, POST /api/v1/notifications/read-all, POST /api/v1/checkout/{checkoutId}/calculate-tax, GET /ready) and 1,133 lines differed, including loose [key: string]: unknown shapes and pre-fix required pagination parameters. The admin app called the notification routes through 'as any'. Generation required a running server at /docs/json (disabled in production since P01-41) and nothing detected drift.
findings.change: scripts/maintenance/generate-api-client.ts builds the API in-process with an explicit synthetic environment (createServer now accepts an environment), runs openapi-typescript, and writes or --check compares the committed client. Root scripts generate:api-client/check:api-client; CI runs the check after type-check. Client regenerated.
findings.verification: Operation-level diff before regeneration; --check fails before and passes after; generation is deterministic (generate then check); all 7 workspace type-check tasks pass before and after regeneration.

findings.problem: /api/auth/sync parsed any body as JSON and checked neither Origin nor Content-Type, so a cross-site text/plain form could plant another account's access token (login CSRF); Server Components then prefetch /auth/me and the profile with that cookie. /api/auth/clear allowed cross-site logout. A 30-day refresh-token cookie was set although no server code reads it. Token type/size were not validated.
findings.change: New isSameOriginRequest guard (Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin, or Origin matching X-Forwarded-Host/Host for browsers without Fetch Metadata) on both routes; sync also requires application/json and a non-empty string token up to 4,096 characters; refresh-token cookie no longer set (still cleared for old cookies); client no longer sends the refresh token.
findings.verification: 14 route-handler cases: baseline 4 pass/10 fail (cross-site text/plain accepted with 200); final 14 pass. Web type-check and next lint pass.

findings.problem: The image ran Node.js 20 (end of life April 2026) as root with no HEALTHCHECK, under three wrapper processes (npm exec -> tsx CLI -> node). CI also used Node 20 while development uses Node 24.
findings.change: node:24-alpine for all stages and CI; USER node with root-owned read-only files; HEALTHCHECK on /health; CMD node --import tsx so Node is PID 1; pnpm exec prisma generate.
findings.verification: Both images built and probed with an unreachable datasource. Baseline: root, v20.20.2, npm exec as PID 1, no health check; SIGTERM still produced graceful shutdown (the suspected signal-forwarding defect did not reproduce). Fixed: node user, v24.22.3, node as PID 1, /health 200, Docker health 'healthy', SIGTERM graceful exit 0, short production JWT secret exits 1 naming only JWT_SECRET.

findings.problem: fastify-plugin (7 runtime files) was not declared and @prisma/client (80 runtime files) was only a devDependency. The API resolved fastify-plugin solely through the NODE_PATH that pnpm's .bin/tsx shim injects; plain node resolution failed in both images, so the corrected Docker CMD initially crashed with 'Cannot find module fastify-plugin'.
findings.change: Declare fastify-plugin ^5.1.0 (installed 5.1.0) and move @prisma/client ^6.16.1 to dependencies; lockfile updated offline with no version changes (pnpm also re-serialised eslint-plugin-import peer suffixes).
findings.verification: Backend-wide bare-import scan against declared dependencies; frozen offline install passes; fixed image boots under plain node.

findings.problem: The shared ESLint preset had no consumer (apps use next lint with .eslintrc.json) and could not load (eslint-config-prettier is not installed). The shared/application compatibility barrel had no importer.
findings.change: Removed both and the preset's package exports.
findings.verification: Repository-wide consumer search; root, tooling and workspace compilers pass after removal.

reviewed_without_change: apps/web/middleware.ts: presence-only cookie gate is documented; the API validates tokens.
packages/config prettier preset and tsconfig presets: consumed and consistent.
packages/api-client/src/index.ts and its tests: retry/refresh/unwrap behaviour unchanged.

final.full_unit: 1428 tests in 108 files passed (one earlier run reported a ~33-hour duration timeout during host sleep; the test passes in isolation and in the final run)
final.workspace_type_check: 7/7 turbo type-check tasks pass; root and tooling tsc pass; tooling lint passes

follow_ups: Admin app still calls notification routes with 'as any' casts that the regenerated client now makes unnecessary (frontend/P14).

Runtime image is about 2 GB because it copies the whole workspace node_modules (frontend and dev tooling included) and runs TypeScript via tsx; a pruned production install or compiled build is a separate decision.
Prisma schema uses the deprecated multiSchema preview flag (P02).
No real HTTPS/proxy deployment verified Secure cookie or X-Forwarded-Host behaviour.
